summary: Strengthen audit scoping, evidence review, assurance mapping, and reporting in a five-day course. Explore the outline and choose your next step.
lede: Advanced auditing helps internal audit and assurance professionals scope complex engagements and connect control evidence to conclusions. Participants practise risk-based planning, control testing, and evidence review, then map assurance coverage and use spreadsheet analysis to identify exceptions and prepare clear audit reports.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who plan, conduct, review, or rely on internal audit and assurance work, and who need to strengthen the link between risk, evidence, and reporting.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of audit planning, internal controls, and audit workpapers is expected. No coding is required.
